choices.why: No candidate is mustard velvet, so this cognac leather three-seater is the closest: its warm golden-tan color brings the cheerful warmth the user wanted, which the black velvet would not.
A classic natural rattan tub armchair that is exactly the relaxed bohemian accent the user asked for and pairs with the warm sofa.
At 335x239 cm it is the only rug large enough to sit under both the sofa and the armchair, and its blue, orange and cream pattern adds lots of color.
Teal medallion patterned cushions bring color and pattern and pick up the blue of the rug, with three on the sofa and one on the armchair.

None of the candidates covers both the plant and the ceramic pot, so I chose the actual plant: trailing ivy brings the green life the room needs, spread across the bookcase, the balcony door and a corner.

Its listed height of 43 cm and width of 140 cm suit the spot under the back-wall window without blocking the light, and its wood and black metal fit the warm look, though its photo suggests a much taller unit, so the height is worth checking.
This round carved-wood drum table is pure boho and echoes the rattan and natural textures.
A turned-wood column with a linen shade gives a warm, homely light that fits the bohemian style better than the chrome lamps.
The cream throw with twisted fringe and color accents looks great on cognac leather and adds the lived-in feel the user asked for.

answer.why: The cognac leather, natural rattan and carved wood create a warm, earthy base. The large blue and orange rug, the teal cushions and the greenery add the color and life the user wanted, set off well by the light walls and parquet floor.
